content:
The average pencil can draw a line that's about 35 miles long before the graphite is completely used up.

This is the kind of fact that gets shared a lot but doesn't really change your day or spark much excitement - just a mildly interesting piece of trivia about an everyday object that most people will forget within a few minutes.
